name: hcs-track-log
description: Template for tamper-evident records on Hedera HCS: blind SHA-256 commitments on a multi-sig topic, Postgres as a read cache, and verification by recomputing each hash from content. Ships with a cargo-tracking demo.

envVars.description: .env. Hedera network: testnet, previewnet or mainnet (default testnet).
.env. Operator account id (0.0.x): pays for topic creation and approval schedules. Not a submit key.
.env. Operator private key (DER or hex). Placeholder only in .env.example; never commit a real key.
.env. Topic id (0.0.x) printed by `npm run topic:create`.
.env. Comma-separated public keys of the administrators' Hedera WALLET accounts. Becomes the topic's threshold submit key; every message must be approved from these wallets.
.env. Number of wallet approvals required per message (2..N).
.env. DEV ONLY: private keys used by `npm run db:seed` to sign directly. The web server never reads them.
.env. Comma-separated public keys of topic administrators. Becomes the topic's threshold admin key (required to update or delete the topic).
.env. Admin private keys used only by `npm run topic:create` to co-sign topic creation. Not needed by the running server.
.env. Mirror node base URL used for verification (default https://testnet.mirrornode.hedera.com).
.env. Test database for `npm run test`; its schema is dropped on every run and its name must end in _test (default postgres://hcs:hcs@localhost:5432/hcs_track_log_test).
.env. WalletConnect Cloud project id (from dashboard.reown.com) for connecting administrators' Hedera wallets.
.env. HMAC key (at least 32 chars) for wallet sign-in challenges and admin session cookies. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
.env, optional. Hours a proposal waits for wallet approvals (default 24, max 1488).

steps.text: hcs-track-log uses the Hedera Consensus Service directly; there are no Solidity contracts to deploy. Postgres is required.

steps.label: Copy the env file and fill in your operator account and submitter keys
Dev only: generate 2-of-3 submit and admin key sets and paste the printed lines into .env
Create the HCS topic with threshold admin and submit keys, then set HCS_TOPIC_ID in .env
Dev only: anchor a demo parcel, signing directly with HCS_SUBMIT_SIGNER_KEYS (they must be submit keys)
Open the administrator console, connect your Hedera wallet and sign in; proposals execute once enough administrators approve them in their wallets
Verify every event on the topic from the command line
Read the architecture and trust model
steps.text: See README.md (the template), packages/nextjs/README.md (the demo) and AGENTS.md.
